author: lov.31
title: Over it.
content:
I get so frustrated every time I use this app. The picture resizing is ridiculous. I should be able to just type in the size I want rather than having to manually resize it myself. The amount of time I have spent dancing between 5.01 and 4.99 to get it to 5.00 is insane. Then trying to use paper that is already the size I want doesn’t work either because it does not allow me to print without boarders. Like you really think I want borders on my picture when the paper is 4x6? No I really don’t. 

Also not necessarily the app but the ink subscription is also ridiculous. I get it says that it “charges per page” but I don’t care you’re ripping people off. It has charged me over $30 a month for the past three months and I have had the same ink cartridges since I put the insta ink ones in. author: Man ol man
title: Hp printers suck
content:
Can’t print anything if you’re not logged into the account; household needs to ask you if you can print something for them every time (won’t show up as air print). 
I went out and bought a dual band printer so it can access 2.4 ghz and it still seems every other time I want to print something it has network issues.
If instant ink sends you cartridges and something happens with subscription the cartridges regardless of capacity will no longer work.
To print through the app, the [network]connection has to travel around the world, under the sea, to the nearest cell tower to the printer, back around the world to the phone, and once more to the printer. 
In all honesty, it deserves maybe 2.5 stars because it “prints”but with so many intricacies, the difficult ease of use, “AI” , network dependent, hp willing, sign in twice for your safety bs , it is slop.
What happened to the days when you simply find a printer on a device and print?
